🛠️ Check centering before you grade? Here's a free tool for it

Centering check on market.driveyourstyle.net (link in bio):
1. Take a photo of the front (raw, sleeved or slabbed all work)
2. Line up the edges and the art border
3. See your centering % and the best PSA, CGC and BGS grade it allows
Your photo stays on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.

Free, no sign-up. Pokémon, One Piece, Lorcana, Riftbound and 6 more games, prices updated every night.
